svg.title: enrutador
svg.text: New · open source · Claude Code mod
My Claude plan ran out by midweek.
Now I end the week with
A ~500-line mod that decides, request by request, whether Sonnet is enough or Opus is
needed. Haiku classifies in ~1 s and, when in doubt, Opus wins.
my real usage, not a benchmark

g.text: limit hit · no Claude for the rest of the week
rename this variable → Sonnet · low · trivial
what does this regex do? → Sonnet · low · trivial
login is broken → Opus · medium · medium
design the migration → Opus · high · complex
